candidates.source_name: NBS – Legislatíva (dohľad nad finančným trhom), searchable legislative document register
candidates.why_relevant: Central searchable register of NBS national legal acts: zákony, vyhlášky, opatrenia, metodické usmernenia, rozhodnutia, odporúčania. Page exposes a filter tool with fields for document name/number, year, regulatory area (oblasť regulácie) and document type — i.e. it is machine-navigable for systematic harvesting of every SK banking/payments regulatory instrument.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the filter/list endpoint per year and per document type; each hit resolves to a /detail-dokumentu/<slug>/ page with title, number, date and attached PDF. Diff the list weekly to detect new opatrenia and metodické usmernenia.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched legislation hub, followed to national-legislation subsection
queries_used: NBS opatrenie banky platobné služby vestník Národná banka Slovenska
nbs.sk legislatíva národná legislatíva

candidates.source_name: NBS – Legislatíva hub (dohľad nad finančným trhom)
candidates.why_relevant: Top-level pointer that enumerates every NBS legal/supervisory publication stream: národná legislatíva, právo EÚ, dohody o spolupráci, sprievodca právnymi predpismi, materiály na pripomienkové konanie, materiály na konzultáciu, usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu prijaté NBS. Best single entry point for mapping the whole A3 surface and for snowballing new sub-portals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic structural crawl of the hub's link graph to detect newly added subsections; use as seed for the child collectors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of hub URL inferred from search results
queries_used: nbs.sk dohľad nad finančným trhom legislatíva

candidates.source_name: NBS – Metodické usmernenia útvarov dohľadu nad finančným trhom
candidates.why_relevant: Metodické usmernenia are NBS's soft-law supervisory expectations — the clearest statement of how NBS will actually supervise banks and payment institutions (ICAAP, AML/CFT, licensing notifications, ESG naming, unauthorised business). Numbered sequentially per year (č. X/YYYY), so gaps in a harvest are detectable. Observed live examples span 2023–2026.
candidates.legal_status: public official regulator publication (non-binding methodological guidance)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filter the legislative register by document type = metodické usmernenie; enumerate č. 1..N per year; fetch detail page + attached PDF.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska metodické usmernenie dohľad nad finančným trhom

candidates.source_name: NBS – Metodické usmernenia a stanoviská k AML/CFT (ochrana pred legalizáciou príjmov z trestnej činnosti)
candidates.why_relevant: Topic-scoped landing page collecting NBS AML/CFT guidance and opinions for banks and payment/e-money institutions, including adoption of EBA guidelines. AML/CFT is the highest-friction compliance workstream for SK payment institutions and drives concrete deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the page's document list; diff monthly.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska metodické usmernenie dohľad nad finančným trhom
local_language_terms_used: ochrana pred legalizáciou príjmov z trestnej činnosti

candidates.source_name: NBS – Materiály na konzultáciu (consultation materials)
candidates.why_relevant: The pre-legislative early-warning channel: NBS publishes konzultačné materiály (e.g. intervention measures on CFDs and binary options) with a comment address and a fixed comment window (observed: 10 working days from publication). Gives lead time on rules before they are adopted, and reveals NBS policy intent.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the section tree (it has per-sector child pages, e.g. trh cenných papierov) plus the /aktuality/ 'Oznámenie o začatí konzultácie' items; extract deadline dates into a deadline calendar.
queries_used: nbs.sk konzultácie verejná konzultácia legislatíva návrh opatrenia pripomienkovanie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Materiály na pripomienkové konanie za NBS (draft regulations open for comment)
candidates.why_relevant: Distinct from 'konzultácia': this is the formal Slovak pripomienkové konanie stream where NBS's own draft opatrenia/vyhlášky are exposed for comment. Earliest reliable signal of a forthcoming binding NBS act and its intended effective date.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl; pair each draft with its later adopted act in the legislative register to measure draft→adoption lag.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link extracted from NBS legislation hub page
queries_used: nbs.sk konzultácie verejná konzultácia legislatíva návrh opatrenia pripomienkovanie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu prijaté NBS alebo Rezolučnou radou (EBA/ESMA/EIOPA guidelines adopted by NBS)
candidates.why_relevant: Records NBS's formal comply-or-explain adoption of EBA/ESMA guidelines — the mechanism by which EU-level payment/banking rules become SK supervisory expectations, with application dates. Essential for mapping EU deadlines onto the SK market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl list; extract guideline reference (EBA/GL/YYYY/NN), NBS adoption status and application date.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link extracted from NBS legislation hub page
queries_used: nbs.sk dohľad nad finančným trhom legislatíva

candidates.source_name: Vestník NBS (Journal of Národná banka Slovenska)
candidates.why_relevant: The legally authoritative publication venue for NBS legal acts not published in the Zbierka zákonov. NBS explicitly states the only binding text for the public is the printed Vestník edition; the web page provides year-by-year archives 1993–2026. Definitive for citation and for confirming a measure's official number and date.
candidates.access_status: open (web archive index); binding text is print-only, orderable via vestnik@nbs.sk
candidates.legal_status: official gazette of the central bank
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl per-year archive pages (pattern https://nbs.sk/legislativa/vestnik-nbs/<year>/) for issue listings; use as authority cross-check, not as primary full-text source, since the binding version is the printed edition.
queries_used: NBS opatrenie banky platobné služby vestník Národná banka Slovenska

candidates.source_name: SLOV-LEX – Zbierka zákonov SR / chronologický register opatrení (NBS measures)
candidates.why_relevant: Government legal portal carrying NBS opatrenia both as Z.z. items and in a dedicated chronologický register opatrení with stable, guessable URL patterns (/SK/OP/<year>/<no>/vyhlasene_znenie.html and /SK/ZZ/<year>/<no>/). Provides consolidated wording, downloadable PDF/DOCX/ASiCE and the legislative process trail — a far more machine-friendly complement to nbs.sk for the binding text.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the chronological register by year/number; also monitor Z.z. items whose title starts 'Opatrenie Národnej banky Slovenska'. Prefer consolidated (úplné znenie) versions and capture účinnosť dates for the deadline calendar.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search, snowballed from NBS opatrenie titles
queries_used: Slov-Lex zbierka zákonov opatrenie Národnej banky Slovenska vyhľadávanie právne predpisy portal

candidates.source_name: NBS – Dohľad: Platobné služby a elektronické peniaze (payment institutions, EMI, AISP)
candidates.why_relevant: The sector-specific supervisory hub for the payments vertical: licensing procedure (postup podania žiadosti) broken into individually addressable conditions (Podmienka A..Q), pre-application and post-application steps, and a licensing handbook PDF. This is where NBS states its actual supervisory benchmarks and expectations for PI/EMI/AISP applicants and incumbents.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full recursive crawl of the subtree including each 'podmienka-*' page and the attached Príručka PDF; diff to detect tightened/loosened licensing expectations.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search on licensing terms + subtree snowball
queries_used: NBS povoľovacia činnosť licencie banka platobná inštitúcia žiadosť podmienky nbs.sk povolenia

candidates.source_name: NBS (EN) – Payment services and electronic money / Payment institutions and AISP
candidates.why_relevant: English mirror of the payments supervision hub. Useful for cross-checking terminology and for non-SK-reading analysts, but NBS states explicitly that only the Slovak texts in the Zbierka zákonov or Vestník NBS have legal force and that recent amendments may not yet be translated — so the EN tree lags and must not be the primary collection target.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl as a secondary/glossary layer; always pair each EN page with its SK counterpart and record translation lag.
queries_used: National Bank of Slovakia English supervisory measures legal acts payment institutions nbs.sk/en

candidates.source_name: NBS (EN) – Slovakia: legal acts and other documents / Laws within the NBS competence
candidates.why_relevant: Curated English list of the core SK financial-market statutes (Act No 483/2001 on banks, Act No 492/2009 on payment services, Act No 186/2009 on financial intermediation, etc.) with translations. Fastest way to build the statutory backbone/actor map for the cell; carries an explicit caveat that only the Slovak original has legal force.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off harvest to seed the statute registry, then re-check annually; track amendments via SLOV-LEX rather than here.
queries_used: National Bank of Slovakia English supervisory measures legal acts payment institutions nbs.sk/en

candidates.source_name: NBS – Aktuality (news / regulator announcements feed)
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-velocity NBS channel. Carries consultation-opening notices, komuniké of Banková rada decisions, warnings about unauthorised entities, EBA guideline effective-date reminders, and supervisory statements — often days before the structured legislative register is updated. The site offers a notification subscription ('Prihlásenie na odber notifikácií').
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the aktuality listing with pagination; classify items by keyword (opatrenie, konzultácia, upozornenie, komuniké, usmernenie). No RSS endpoint confirmed — see negative_findings; fall back to HTML diffing or the on-site notification subscription.
candidates.discovered_via_method: repeated appearance across sk searches; snowballed
queries_used: nbs.sk RSS feed aktuality odber noviniek dohľad
nbs.sk konzultácie verejná konzultácia legislatíva návrh opatrenia pripomienkovanie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre dohľadu / subjekty.nbs.sk (register of supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative register of licensed banks, payment institutions, EMIs, AISPs, intermediaries and creditors; NBS's own FAQ directs the public to subjekty.nbs.sk to verify whether an entity is supervised and permitted to operate in SK. Backbone for the actor map and for detecting new market entrants/licence withdrawals — an indirect but reliable regulatory-action signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot the register per entity type on a monthly cadence and diff; check subjekty.nbs.sk for an export/API before resorting to HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search + snowball from NBS FAQ
queries_used: NBS sankcie rozhodnutia dohľadu zoznam sankcií register dohliadaných subjektov
NBS upozornenia varovania neoprávnené podnikanie zoznam subjektov nbs.sk dohľad

candidates.source_name: NBS – Metodická a sankčná činnosť (methodological and sanctioning activity)
candidates.why_relevant: Documents how NBS applies sanctions in practice, including the rozkaz o uložení sankcie fast-track for minor breaches (fines up to EUR 5,000 plus remedial measures). Enforcement patterns are the sharpest read on real supervisory priorities, beyond what the written rules say.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl this page plus sector 'rozhodnutia' pages; extract entity, breach type, sanction, date into an enforcement time series.
queries_used: NBS sankcie rozhodnutia dohľadu zoznam sankcií register dohliadaných subjektov

candidates.source_name: NBS – Upozornenia / varovania na neoprávnené podnikanie (public warnings on unauthorised firms)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS issues named warnings about entities operating without authorisation or misusing the NBS name. These are the fastest public evidence of NBS supervisory attention and of grey-market activity in SK payments/investments. Published mainly as aktuality items rather than in one consolidated register on the new site.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword filter on the aktuality crawl for 'upozornenie', 'varovanie', 'neoprávnen*'; locate and confirm whether a consolidated warning-list page exists on the current site.
queries_used: NBS upozornenia varovania neoprávnené podnikanie zoznam subjektov nbs.sk dohľad

candidates.source_name: NBS – Informácie pre vykazujúce subjekty / IS STATUS-DFT reporting system
candidates.why_relevant: The operational compliance layer: NBS's reporting system for supervised entities (banks, PIs, EMIs), with all-participant guidance, electronic form definitions (DBVD DFT database) and onboarding/access procedures. Reporting obligations and their submission calendars are the single densest source of recurring regulatory deadlines, and changes to výkazy signal new supervisory data demands.
candidates.access_status: open documentation; the STATUS-DFT system itself is credentialed (administrator/user access request required)
candidates.legal_status: public official regulator publication; system access restricted to reporting entities
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the public documentation subtree only; cross-reference form/výkaz identifiers with the opatrenia that mandate them (e.g. opatrenie o predkladaní výkazov bankami) to build a deadline calendar. Do NOT attempt access to the credentialed system.
queries_used: NBS vykazovanie dohliadaných subjektov termíny STATUS DFT reporting banky platobné inštitúcie

candidates.source_name: NBS – Makroprudenciálna politika: makroprudenciálny komentár a rozhodnutia Bankovej rady (CCyB, buffers)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly commentary plus the Banková rada decisions setting the proticyklický kapitálový vankúš and other buffers. Macroprudential decisions are binding on SK banks, carry explicit application dates, and are published on a predictable quarterly cadence — high-value for a regulatory deadline calendar. NBS exercises macroprudential powers as part of financial market supervision.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch of the makroprudenciálny komentár PDF plus the associated aktuality komuniké; extract buffer rate, decision date and effective date.
queries_used: nbs.sk "makroprudenciálna politika" rozhodnutie proticyklický kapitálový vankúš banky

candidates.source_name: NBS – Správa o činnosti útvaru dohľadu nad finančným trhom (annual supervision activity report)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual retrospective on what NBS actually did: inspections carried out, sanctions imposed, licensing volumes, thematic priorities. Converts scattered individual acts into measurable supervisory-intensity trends, and often previews next-year priorities. Available for a long back-run (2019–2024+), also in EN.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest of the full back-run; parse sanction/inspection counts into a time series.
queries_used: NBS správa o činnosti dohľadu nad finančným trhom výročná správa publikácie analýza slovenského finančného sektora

candidates.source_name: NBS – Inovačný hub a regulačný sandbox (FinTech innovation facilitators)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS's regulatory-dialogue channel for fintech and payments innovation (Inovačný hub since 2019, regulačný sandbox since early 2022), with an annual report on hub/sandbox activity. Reveals NBS's stance on emerging payment business models before any formal rule exists, and which innovation themes are under supervisory examination.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual harvest of the Správa o inovačnom hube a regulačnom sandboxe PDF plus keyword monitoring of aktuality for 'sandbox' / 'inovačný hub'. Locate the stable section URL on the current site (documents are currently served via opaque /dokument/<uuid>/ links).
queries_used: NBS inovačný hub regulačný sandbox fintech nbs.sk

candidates.source_name: NBS – Dohľad kryptoaktív (MiCA) a Digitálna prevádzková odolnosť / Register informácií (DORA)
candidates.why_relevant: The two newest supervisory workstreams touching banks and payment firms: MiCA crypto-asset licensing/supervision and DORA's Register informácií (ICT third-party register) with hard submission deadlines. High deadline density and high relevance to payments-technology vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl both subtrees; extract submission windows and templates into the deadline calendar; monitor for new licensing decisions under MiCA.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from sk-language searches on registers and supervision
queries_used: NBS sankcie rozhodnutia dohľadu zoznam sankcií register dohliadaných subjektov
nbs.sk RSS feed aktuality odber noviniek dohľad

candidates.source_name: NBS – Dear CEO letters / supervisory communications to payment service providers
candidates.why_relevant: Direct supervisory correspondence addressed to boards of payment-services firms — an unusually candid statement of NBS's supervisory expectations and concerns, of a kind rarely captured in formal legal registers. Found on the legacy www.nbs.sk document tree, which suggests such letters may not be systematically indexed on the new site.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted site: search for 'dear CEO' and 'list dohliadaným subjektom' across both nbs.sk and the legacy www.nbs.sk/_img/documents tree; archive PDFs on discovery since legacy paths are migration-fragile.
candidates.discovered_via_method: surfaced in sk-language reporting search; legacy document tree
queries_used: NBS vykazovanie dohliadaných subjektov termíny STATUS DFT reporting banky platobné inštitúcie

candidates.source_name: Legacy NBS site (www.nbs.sk) – pre-migration document and news archive
candidates.why_relevant: NBS migrated to a new information architecture (nbs.sk/...) but a large legacy corpus remains addressable at www.nbs.sk/sk/... and www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/..., including older supervisory news, macroprudential commentaries and consultation evaluations. Necessary for historical depth and for recovering documents whose new-site links 404.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off deep archival crawl of the legacy tree with local PDF retention; treat 404s as migration artefacts and re-resolve titles against the new site rather than marking documents dead.
candidates.discovered_via_method: legacy URLs appearing across multiple sk searches

candidates.source_name: NBS – Nahlasovanie porušení (whistleblowing channel)
candidates.why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: the existence, scope and stated handling procedure of NBS's breach-reporting channel documents which breach categories NBS treats as actionable, and is a structural input into future enforcement. Low content volume but useful for completing the supervisory-process map.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off capture; re-check annually for procedural changes.
queries_used: NBS upozornenia varovania neoprávnené podnikanie zoznam subjektov nbs.sk dohľad

candidates.source_name: NBS – Sprievodca právnymi predpismi (guide to legal instrument types)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS's own taxonomy of document types and their binding force under EU and national law. This is the schema authority for classifying harvested documents (opatrenie vs metodické usmernenie vs odporúčanie vs stanovisko vs rozhodnutie) — indispensable for building a correct ontology rather than guessing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch to derive the document-type controlled vocabulary for the collection schema.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link extracted from NBS legislation hub page
queries_used: nbs.sk dohľad nad finančným trhom legislatíva

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for an RSS/Atom feed for NBS aktuality and the supervision news stream ('nbs.sk RSS feed aktuality odber noviniek dohľad'). No RSS endpoint was found in search results. Evidence only of an on-site 'Prihlásenie na odber notifikácií' (notification subscription) control.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed RSS/Atom URL for nbs.sk. An email/on-site notification subscription appears to exist but its mechanics were not established.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for the highest-velocity NBS channel will likely require HTML crawling and diffing rather than feed polling, which raises fragility and cost. A feed may still exist at an unadvertised path (e.g. /feed, /rss) and should be probed directly.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a consolidated NBS sanctions register / list of imposed sanctions ('zoznam sankcií', 'rozhodnutia dohľadu'). Found the 'Metodická a sankčná činnosť' page and sector-specific 'Rozhodnutia' pages (e.g. under MiFID II/MiFIR), but no single cross-sector register of enforcement decisions against banks and payment institutions surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Enforcement decisions appear to be scattered across sector pages and aktuality rather than centrally registered; no unified sanctions register URL identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement is the sharpest signal of real supervisory priorities. Without a central register, the collector must stitch together several sector subtrees, and coverage completeness cannot be guaranteed.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a consolidated NBS public-warning list on unauthorised business ('upozornenia', 'varovania', 'neoprávnené podnikanie'). Individual warnings were found as /aktuality/ items, and a third-party aggregator (banky.sk/varovania-nbs) surfaced, but a canonical NBS warning-list page on the current site was not identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Warnings confirmed to exist and be published, but only as dispersed news items; canonical index page unlocated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risks under-collection of grey-market signals and forces reliance on keyword filtering of the news stream, or on a non-authoritative third-party aggregator.

negative_findings.description: NBS states on its Vestník NBS page that the only binding wording of NBS legal regulations intended for the public is the version published in printed (listinná) form of the Vestník NBS; the website offers year-by-year archives (1993–2026) and an order address (vestnik@nbs.sk), functioning as a directory rather than full electronic publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: The legally authoritative text of some NBS acts is print-only by NBS's own declaration.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated collection of NBS opatrenia is by definition a non-binding copy. For acts also published in the Zbierka zákonov, SLOV-LEX provides an authoritative electronic substitute; for Vestník-only acts, a residual legal-certainty gap remains.

negative_findings.description: NBS's English legislation pages carry an explicit statement that only the original Slovak texts published in the Zbierka zákonov or the Vestník NBS have legal force, and that the most recent amendments may not yet have been translated into English.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English tree is an incomplete, lagging mirror by the regulator's own admission.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovak-language collection is mandatory for this cell and that any English-only pipeline would systematically miss the newest measures and deadlines.

negative_findings.description: The IS STATUS-DFT reporting system used by banks and payment institutions to submit výkazy to NBS requires administrator and user access-rights requests; only its surrounding documentation and electronic form definitions are public.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reporting content is behind authentication; only the reporting metadata layer (guidance, form catalogue, onboarding) is openly collectable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Actual reported data is out of reach; deadline intelligence must be derived from the mandating opatrenia and the public form catalogue instead.

coverage_gaps.description: The legislative register at nbs.sk/dohlad-nad-financnym-trhom/legislativa/narodna-legislativa/ exposes a filter UI (name/number, year, area, document type) but the underlying result list did not render in the fetched content — it is likely populated by JavaScript or a POST/query endpoint.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Inspect the page's network calls with a browser-capable agent to identify the JSON/query endpoint behind the filter; if none exists, plan for a headless-browser collector rather than plain HTTP fetching.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers NBS only. Adjacent SK regulatory actors that co-produce banking/payments rules and deadlines were not scouted: Ministerstvo financií SR (author of the underlying zákony), NR SR (parliamentary legislative process for e.g. zákon o platobných službách 492/2009, zákon o bankách 483/2001), Rezolučná rada, and the Slovak Banking Association (SBA).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a follow-on cell for MF SR / NR SR / Rezolučná rada / SBA, and cross-link their outputs to the NBS acts they trigger.

coverage_gaps.description: A large share of SK banking supervision originates at ECB/SSM, EBA and the EU level, and NBS acts partly as transposer/adopter. The ECB/SSM and EBA source layer was out of this cell's scope and was not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an EU-layer cell (ECB Banking Supervision, EBA guidelines and Q&A, EUR-Lex) and link EU instruments to their NBS adoption records via the 'usmernenia európskych orgánov dohľadu' page.

coverage_gaps.description: Deadlines are embedded in prose and PDFs across at least five distinct NBS streams (opatrenia účinnosť dates, consultation comment windows, EBA guideline application dates, DORA register submission windows, reporting calendars). No single structured deadline source exists.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a cross-stream deadline extractor keyed on SK date/effect phrases ('nadobúda účinnosť', 'do 10 pracovných dní', 'k termínu', 'najneskôr do') and normalise into one calendar; validate against SLOV-LEX účinnosť metadata where available.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS serves many documents via opaque UUID paths (nbs.sk/dokument/<uuid>/stiahnut) and retains a partially migrated legacy tree (www.nbs.sk/_img/documents/...). Both are fragile anchors for long-term monitoring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Persist local copies plus content hashes of every harvested PDF; key records on document number+date rather than URL, and treat 404s as migration events requiring title-based re-resolution, not as dead sources.

brief: For Slovak banking and payments regulation, NBS is effectively a self-contained, high-density source estate: a filterable national legislative register (opatrenia, metodické usmernenia, rozhodnutia), a two-track pre-legislative pipeline (materiály na pripomienkové konanie for NBS's own drafts, materiály na konzultáciu for intervention measures with fixed comment windows), a sector supervision hub for platobné inštitúcie/IEP/AISP that spells out licensing conditions condition-by-condition, plus registers, macroprudential Banková rada decisions and an annual supervision activity report. The binding-text layer is split: acts reaching the Zbierka zákonov are cleanly machine-accessible on SLOV-LEX under stable /SK/OP/<year>/<no>/ and /SK/ZZ/ patterns, while NBS itself declares the only binding version of its public regulations to be the printed Vestník NBS. Slovak-language collection is non-negotiable — NBS states its English pages are unofficial translations that may lag the newest amendments. The main practical obstacles are structural rather than legal: no confirmed RSS feed, no consolidated cross-sector sanctions or warnings register, a JavaScript-driven legislative filter, and opaque UUID document URLs alongside a half-migrated legacy site.
